Gatlinburg, TN, United States



16 guests

7 bedrooms

4 bathrooms

Welcome to Mauna Nani, a brand-new, custom-built luxury cabin where breathtaking Smoky Mountain views meet modern design and upscale comfort. With 7 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and sleeps 16 guests, this home was thoughtfully designed for families, friends, and groups who want the perfect mix of relaxation and entertainment.

### Good to know

Plan your perfect spring escape at our cozy cabin, where fresh mountain air, blooming landscapes, and peaceful surroundings create the perfect setting for a relaxing getaway. Start your mornings on the porch with a cup of coffee, take in the sights and sounds of nature coming back to life, and unwind as the sun sets behind the mountains. Your springtime retreat is waiting. Come make it yours!

From the moment you enter, you’ll be greeted by a large, beautiful tree fountain, a unique feature that immediately sets the tone for your stay. The soothing sound of water pairs perfectly with the soaring ceilings, custom finishes, and walls of windows that frame the mountains. The main level is the heart of the home, featuring a spacious living room with a seasonal electric fireplace and Smart TV, and opening onto expansive decks with outdoor dining and lounge seating. Just off the deck, the game room brings non-stop fun with a full-size pool table that flips into air hockey, foosball, and six multi-game arcade consoles. Nearby, a private home theater is ready for unforgettable movie nights. Two king bedrooms, each with Smart TVs and spa-like bathrooms featuring custom vanities and heated toilet seats, complete this floor.

The kitchen at Mauna Nani is a true showstopper. With stainless steel modern appliances, sleek finishes, and a backsplash that perfectly frames the mountain views. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into the dining area, where a solid oak dining table with seating for 8 invites guests to gather for meals, conversation, and memories made around the table.

On the lower level, you’ll find even more ways to gather: a wet bar with a wine cooler, a poker table, and two king bedrooms with Smart TVs. Step outside to the private hot tub overlooking the mountains, the perfect place to unwind after a day of adventure. The top floor includes two more king bedrooms, both with Smart TVs, plus a fun loft with four twin beds that kids will love.

Every inch of Mauna Nani has been designed for both comfort and luxury. This is more than just a cabin; it’s a one-of-a-kind retreat built for creating unforgettable Smoky Mountain memories. Whether you’re cooking a feast in the gourmet kitchen, gathering around the dining table, challenging friends in the game room, enjoying movie night in the theater, or soaking in the hot tub under the stars, Mauna Nani is your dream mountain escape.

We are thrilled to welcome you to Mauna Nani, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 2000+ 5-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new account for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured that your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

LIVING AREAS
The living room at Mauna Nani is the perfect spot to relax and connect. It features a 3-seater couch and two additional chairs, arranged around a large seasonal electric fireplace (Oct–March) and Smart TV. Large windows let in plenty of natural light and offer beautiful mountain views. The open layout flows seamlessly to the dining area and outdoor decks, making it ideal for cozy evenings, family gatherings, or simply enjoying the view.

KITCHEN
The kitchen at Mauna Nani is a modern chef’s dream. Featuring stainless steel appliances, sleek countertops, and a backsplash framing stunning mountain views. Fully stocked with everything you need for a gourmet meal, including cookware, utensils, and serving pieces, the kitchen makes cooking a joy. It's open layout flows to the dining area with an 8-seat table, so you can cook, dine, and entertain all in one space while enjoying the company of family and friends.

DECKS
Step outside onto the spacious main-level decks at Mauna Nani, where breathtaking mountain views surround you. One deck features a private hot tub, the other offers ample seating and outdoor dining space for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or meals with family and friends. Whether you’re soaking in the hot tub, enjoying the fresh mountain air, or simply taking in the scenery, the decks provide the perfect place to unwind and make memories in the Smokies.

MULTIPLE RECREATION AREAS-
Mauna Nani offers multiple recreation areas designed for fun and relaxation for all ages. The main-level game room, located just off the deck, features a full-size pool table that flips into an air hockey table, foosball, and six multi-game arcade consoles—perfect for friendly competitions. A poker table and wet bar with a wine cooler add even more entertainment options. For movie lovers, the cabin also features a private home theater, ideal for family movie nights or binge-watching your favorite shows. With so many spaces for fun and entertainment, everyone can find their favorite way to unwind while enjoying the stunning mountain views.

#### Neighborhood

The cabin is in the premier community of Chalet Village, Gatlinburg, Tennessee, and our property is adjacent to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park. The views from the cabin of the Great Smoky Mountains are breathtaking and we are only 3 miles from downtown Gatlinburg and the entrance to the Smoky Mountains National Park!

Our close proximity to the Great Smoky Mountain National Park means there is lots of wildlife in our area - black bears, deer, wild turkeys, raccoons, coyotes, foxes, and more! Black bears visit the cabin often in Spring, Summer, and Fall. You may get lucky and catch a glimpse of one of these residents while enjoying the view from the deck. The cabin is located on a mountain road. We strongly recommend trip insurance, especially during the Winter since there are no refunds for snow and ice. Welcome to Valley View, where modern luxury meets the timeless beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains. Perched high above the valley to capture sweeping, unobstructed views of Gatlinburg, this freshly updated 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom retreat sleeps up to 12 guests and offers a front-row seat to nature’s most breathtaking moments. Across three spacious levels, this premier cabin features 2 community pools, private hot tub with views, arcade with 3 classic games, shuffle board, full kitchen & game room

### Good to know

We’re thrilled to welcome you to Valley View, our newest cabin! With years of experience hosting guests in the Smokies and over 3,000+ five-star reviews across our properties, we’re committed to providing an exceptional stay. While this is a new listing for properties we manage on behalf of friends and family, rest assured your experience will be nothing short of spectacular.

The main level welcomes you with a bright, open-concept layout where the living room, kitchen, and dining area come together seamlessly. Cozy up by the electric fireplace with plush seating, or gather in the fully stocked kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and generous counter space for everything from quick breakfasts to full family meals. Step outside to the expansive deck, where Adirondack chairs and ample seating provide the perfect place to take in the mountain views. This level also includes a king bedroom with a TV and access to a shared full bathroom with a shower/tub combo.

Upstairs, the top floor is designed for rest and quiet moments. A small workspace and sitting area on the landing offer a peaceful spot to work or unwind. This level features three king bedrooms, each with a TV and private ensuite bathroom with a shower/tub combo. One bedroom includes a twin-over-twin bunk set, while another offers two sleeper chairs for added flexibility. Two of these bedrooms also offer direct access to the upper-level deck, where you’ll find ample seating and breathtaking “bird’s-eye” views of the valley below. It’s an unforgettable backdrop from sunrise to sunset.

The lower level is all about entertainment and relaxation. The game room is packed with amenities including a pool table, shuffleboard, air hockey, foosball, and classic arcade games like Pac-Man, pinball, and a 60+ game multicade. A large TV and high-top seating area make it easy to relax between games. Just beyond, the private theater room features immersive LED lighting and comfortable reclining chairs for the ultimate movie night experience. This level also includes a king bedroom, a shared full bathroom, and a stacked washer and dryer. Step outside to the lower deck to enjoy the private hot tub and additional seating. It’s truly the perfect place to unwind under the stars.

As a guest of Valley View, you'll enjoy full access to the exclusive Gatlinburg Falls Resort amenities, rated the #1 Family Resort in the Smokies by Southern Living Magazine. This includes two full-sized swimming pools, a children’s splash pool, a relaxing hot tub, a scenic waterfall, plenty of lounge chairs, and inviting seating areas perfect for soaking up the sun. You’ll also have access to a community fitness center, making it easy to keep up with your routine while on vacation. OUTDOOR AREAS AND DECKS

Multiple expansive decks across all three levels offer stunning, unobstructed mountain views, with plenty of seating to relax and take it all in.
